title: The parameter set of fibre witnesses (alternative T3) is Borel
statement: Let N, m ∈ ℕ, k := m + 1, let E ⊆ ℝ^N (= Eucl N) be σ-compact and δ ∈ ℝ. For v = (v₁, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^k let L_v(x) := (⟨v₁,x⟩, …, ⟨v_k,x⟩) ∈ ℝᵏ (= Eucl k). Then the set W := {(a, v) ∈ ℝ^N × (ℝ^N)^k : there is x ∈ E with x ≠ a, |x − a| < δ and L_v x = L_v a} is measurable (Borel) in ℝ^N × (ℝ^N)^k.
lean_statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ), IsSigmaCompact E → MeasurableSet {p : Eucl N × (Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N) | ∃ x ∈ E, x ≠ p.1 ∧ dist x p.1 < δ ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (p.2 i) x) : Eucl (m + 1)) = (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (p.2 i) p.1) : Eucl (m + 1))}
